scenes.title: Twenty Paces East
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Lipovy Lane, Kira, Yaroslav, and Roman check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: By the Stone Fountain
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, Kira and Roman spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but Yaroslav insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: The Famous Shortcut
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, Yaroslav leads the group straight back outside Zoya's open café kitchen window at Bridge Courtyard Inn.

scenes.title: Shadow of the Clock Tower
scenes.summary: Joined by Gleb at the municipal clock tower at noon, Kira and Roman watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Under the Bookshop Arch
scenes.summary: Meeting Larisa under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, Kira spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making Larisa gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: The Shaded Park Bench
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Lipovy Lane, Roman places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of Bridge Courtyard Inn with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Opening the Small Envelope
scenes.summary: On the park bench, Kira, Larisa, and Roman break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Message at the Front Desk
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, Kira and Yaroslav find Matvey holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
